title: 第二十章 前台赠品，当场社死
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
嘴上这么说，但其实全身上下分币没有！不睡这里睡哪里？

    说着还往旁边挪了挪，拍了拍身旁的空地，眉眼弯起，“乖徒儿，过来一起躺，为师教你吐纳之法。”

    傅烬川一脸无语：“胡闹。”

    不由分说地直接拽起姜无念，掌心裹住她微凉的指尖，“跟我走。”

    姜无念浑身一松，神魂里那点虚浮感瞬间就淡了，鬼使神差的也不挣扎，乖乖跟着他走。

    两人拐进老城区一个不起眼的小旅馆，昏黄的灯光照着墙上斑驳的墙皮，角落里堆着几把破椅子，看起来有些简陋。

    姜无念揉着眼睛嘟囔：“在哪睡觉不是睡啊，真是多此一举，桥洞睡得多舒服……”

    “两间房。”

    傅烬川把现金拍在前台桌上。

    等了几分钟，一位烫着夸张大波浪，浓妆艳抹的大姐扭着腰从里间出来，扫了眼桌上的钱，拖着声音懒洋洋的：

    “两位真是不巧，只剩一间了。”

    傅烬川有些纠结，下意识看向姜无念，见她半睁着眼一脸无所谓。

    不想暴露自己的行踪，就只有这里不用登记身份信息，傅烬川心里权衡了一会，只得点头应下。

    两人住进来的时候已经是后半夜了，姜无念困得头一点一点的，随手把前台塞的两个方盒子递给他。

    她微微歪着头，随口说道：“老板送的，说是什么套来着，干什么用的？”

    傅烬川低头瞥了一眼，指尖猛地一颤，耳根瞬间烧得通红。

    慌乱地别开眼，他不动声色地把东西丢进垃圾桶，声音发紧：“没什么用，扔了就行。”

    房间很小，两张单人床几乎贴在一起，姜无念沾床就睡，呼吸很快变得均匀。

    傅烬川看了她一眼，这丫头心真大，孤男寡女也不怕自己对她做点什么？还是太过于信任自己了。

    不过他马上就想起了姜无念之前的种种行为，下意识地紧了紧衣服，好像该担心的应该是他才对。

    拉好拉链，扣好纽扣，他才安心躺下，常年神经衰弱难以入睡，可闻着身边姜无念身上淡淡的草木香，竟很快就沉沉睡去了。

    没睡多久，隔壁传来一阵暧昧的呻吟声还有床铺“咯吱”声。
content_en:
You may say so, but in fact, there are no coins in your body! Where can I sleep if I don't sleep here?

    As he spoke, he moved to the side, patted the open space beside him, and arched his eyebrows, "My good disciple, come and lie down together, and I will teach you how to breathe in and out."

    Fu Jinchuan was speechless: "Nonsense."

    Without any explanation, he directly grabbed Jiang Wu Nian, wrapped his palm around her slightly cold fingertips, and said, "Follow me."

    Jiang Wu Nian relaxed all over, and the emptiness in his soul instantly faded away. He didn't even bother to struggle, and followed him obediently.

    The two of them turned into an inconspicuous small hotel in the old city. The dim light illuminated the mottled wall, and there were a few broken chairs piled in the corner, which looked a bit shabby.

    Jiang Wu Nian rubbed his eyes and muttered: "Sleeping somewhere is not sleeping. It's so unnecessary. Sleeping under the bridge is so comfortable..."

    "Two rooms."

    Fu Jinchuan slapped the cash on the front desk.

    After waiting for a few minutes, a lady with exaggerated waves and heavy makeup came out of the room with her waist twisted, glanced at the money on the table, and said in a lazy voice:

    "What a coincidence for you two, there is only one room left."

    Fu Jinchuan was a little confused, and subconsciously looked at Jiang Wunian, seeing her eyes half-opened with an indifferent look on her face.

    Not wanting to expose his whereabouts, this was the only place where he didn't need to register his identity information. Fu Jinchuan weighed it in his mind for a while and had no choice but to nod in agreement.

    It was already late at night when the two of them checked in. Jiang Wu Nian was so sleepy that he handed him the two square boxes stuffed at the front desk.

    She tilted her head slightly and said casually: "The boss gave it to me. What kind of condom is it? What is it used for?"

    Fu Jinchuan glanced down, his fingertips trembled suddenly, and his ears instantly burned red.

    He looked away in panic, and calmly threw the things into the trash can, his voice tight: "It's useless, just throw it away."

    The room was very small, and the two single beds were almost touching each other. Jiang Wunian fell asleep on the bed, and his breathing quickly became even.

    Fu Jinchuan glanced at her, this girl is really big-hearted, how can she be alone and not afraid of doing something to her? I still trust myself too much.

    However, he immediately remembered Jiang Wu Nian's previous actions and subconsciously tightened his clothes, as if he was the one who should be worried.

    After zipping up and buttoning up, he lay down peacefully. He had suffered from neurasthenia all year round and found it difficult to fall asleep. However, smelling the faint scent of grass and trees next to Jiang Wu Nian, he fell into a deep sleep very quickly.

    Not long after I slept, there was an ambiguous moan and a creaking sound from the bed next door.
title_en: Chapter 20: Gift at the front desk, death on the spot
